digest.component_or_area: fsck snapshot rebuild and event log compaction
propositions: fsck snapshot rebuild silently drops history that exists only in a prior snapshot's compiled_state when source events were deleted by pre-16640a705d compactions, causing 214 closed tickets to revert to open or in_progress status with 480 total missing events.

rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log replays from disk without detecting incomplete logs caused by deleted source events, so tickets compacted before the Jul-7 fix lose their folded event history during rebuild.
fsck --repair-snapshots --dry-run mutates the store instead of honoring dry-run mode, making read-only preview impossible before broad legacy rebuilds.
restore_deleted_sources must recover deleted event files from git history as .retired sources and complete the log before rebuild attempts, preventing lossy rewrites of tickets with missing sources.
505 live tickets have snapshots citing source events missing from disk, representing latent exposure to the same silent data loss mechanism.
